title: Integrate the PR #599 follow-ups: summon reversion, uncontrolled 1-hour removal, bonded recast (single PR)
description:
Supervisor-owned integration bead. One branch and one PR carrying eshyra-ysr3 (Animate Objects / Giant Insect 0-HP reversion), eshyra-7vh3 (Conjure Elemental/Fey cast-anchored 1-hour removal after a concentration break) and eshyra-s02z (Find Familiar / Find Steed recast restores an absent bonded creature). Children are serialized (all three touch packages/core/src/state/activeEffects.ts, encounterCombatants.ts and docs/active-effect-lifecycle.md).

DECISIONS (captain, 2026-10-04):
- ysr3 Giant Insect: user chose 'snapshot at cast'. start_effect captures each target's natural form (hit points current/max, optional rulesRef) for a target-transformation spell; reversion (0 HP by any route, spell end, concentration break, per-target action dismissal) restores that form with the HP it had when transformed, no damage carry-over (the source states carry-over only for Animate Objects). The creature stays in play.
- ysr3 Animate Objects: the original form is an object, not a creature: the combatant leaves play (absent), its link closes, the effect ends when no animated object remains, and the result reports the damage beyond 0 carried over to the object (objects are not tracked).
- 7vh3: a concentration break of Conjure Elemental/Fey ends the controlled effect with release (unchanged) and in the same transaction starts a non-concentration, non-dismissible successor effect inheriting the original cast anchor with a 1-hour timer and remove cleanup, so the creature becomes absent at cast+1h.
- s02z: recast operation on the existing bonded effect (Find Steed: same actor, max HP; Find Familiar: restore presence + optional new form); refused after release.
acceptance_criteria: All three follow-up beads' acceptance met on one branch; npm run verify:worktree green on the integration branch; PR opened to main; follow-up beads closed when the PR merges.
